title: Joomla Extension - acymailing.com - Unauthenticated disclosure of mailing list metadata in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 -…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla extension AcyMailing versions 1.0.0 through 11.1.1 allows unauthenticated attackers to disclose mailing list metadata. This includes access to all mailing lists on the site, even those not publicly visible or restricted by access level, along with their descriptions, access levels, owning user accounts, and subscriber counts. The WordPress plugin is not affected.
